title: Peace Village International: Providing medical attention to children living in war zones
author: Ian
body:
Since 1967, Peace Village have been working to provide medical attention to children living in war zones. 

The Germany based initiative, ensures children have access to treatment and physiotherapy in European hospitals and rehabilitate approximately 1,000 children each year through the program. They are then returned to their families and homes after healing. 

Peace Village International provide: 

  • Individual medical aid for sick and injured children impacted by war who cannot receive adequate treatment in their home countries.
  • Aid projects in regions of war and conflict to improve local medical services.
  • Peace education to promote humanitarian awareness and social engagement.

OneTomorrow is a long-time supporter of Peace Village International and have donated $7,000 to their important work. This is inclusive of a recent $2,000 one off grant which OneTomorrow provided to Peace Village as part of the annual 2021 grant program.

On top of these grants, APT Travel Group staff will also be participating in a “Race through Europe” challenge this month, which aims to raise more donations for Peace Village. The virtual race uses the Walker Tracker app, putting staff into teams where they log their activities, progressing them along APT’s Amsterdam to Budapest Magnificent Europe cruise within the app. Teams complete challenges, with winners earning donations to be given to Peace Village.

To learn more about Peace Village International and how you can support, visit our Peace International page.
